summary: The image includes the fastokens tokenizer backend, enabled with VLLM_USE_FASTOKENS=1
details: fastokens 0.3.2 is off by default. With -e VLLM_USE_FASTOKENS=1, vLLM tokenizes a 300K-token agent conversation in 27 ms instead of 450 ms on an EPYC 9575F, which shortens time to first token for long prompts; -e VLLM_USE_FASTOKENS=0 or leaving it unset keeps the standard backend.

No profile enables it yet: token IDs matched the standard backend on real multilingual text, code, chat conversations and 1M-token prompts, but not on every input. The Tokenizer backend section of runtime/README.md lists the differences.
